objections.text: A01 inserts two ProductInventory rows with the same (ProductID, LocationID) pair (1, 6), but that pair is the source table's composite primary key. The overflow input cannot occur under the source schema preconditions.

A02 inserts two ProductInventory rows with the same (ProductID, LocationID) pair (2, 6), but that pair is the source table's composite primary key. The negative overflow input cannot occur under the source schema preconditions.

A03 inserts two ProductInventory rows with the same (ProductID, LocationID) pair (3, 6), but that pair is the source table's composite primary key. The cancelling-sum input cannot occur under the source schema preconditions.
